_note: Success here is code 200, not code 0 as on the /v1/* endpoints. The two families of endpoint genuinely disagree, and a parser that assumes one convention silently drops the other.
_carrybot_gap: This endpoint is LuckiBot-only (zcb). Its metrics are hospitality: deliveries to table, guidance records, passing-by persons, ad plays. No equivalent historical usage endpoint is documented for CarryBot, the warehouse AMR. For CarryBot, history has to come from task callbacks plus status polling until OrionStar says otherwise.

_classify_values.b_delivery_nums: Deliveries to Table. The work count.
_classify_values.active_hour: Working hours of the robot, powered on and connected. The utilisation denominator.
